test_precision: test the precision function by comparing gold reference labels against predicted labels
test_recall: test the recall function by comparing gold reference labels against predicted labels
test_compute_f1: test the compute_f1 function by passing precision and recall values and checking the result
test_average_score: test the average_score function by passing lists of actual and predicted scores with a scoring function
run_evaluation_tests: run the unittest suite for precision, recall, f1, and average_score evaluation scoring functions
